note: Corrections to v0.120. Three claims in its note were wrong and are fixed there and owned here: the blank-pressure behaviour is not desktop OpenRocket's rule (desktop ignores both fields on a RASAero import), the nozzle data covers 28 of AeroTech's 32 in-production 98 mm motors rather than all of them, and the launch-weight correction reaches only designs imported since v0.120 - re-import an older one from its RASAero file. The correction itself also subtracted whichever motor you loaded from a weight containing a different one, and could be undone, scaled or hand-edited into a wrong number; it now applies only to the motor the file named and clears the override otherwise. The temperature help pointed at the mirror of the trap the release was about, and the pad-pressure figure could read NaN at a very high site.
